scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent pauses of 35s and 38s while testing exchange circuits, prompting customer chasing on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the caller by name ('Grace') throughout the entire 16-minute interaction.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent handled the opening distress well, but when Grace had a severe emotional outburst at turn 45 in the final third regarding emergency foster care safeguarding, Ian responded with cold policy citations.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeatedly deflected responsibility onto customer's handset hardware, refused an engineer line inspection, and insisted the customer purchase replacement equipment despite the customer testing the phone next door.

grader.scenario: Landline incoming calls going straight to busy tone while outgoing calls work
grader.notes: Landline incoming engaged tone fault call handled by Ian. Customer (emergency foster carer) could make outgoing calls but incoming calls received busy tones. Agent diagnosed network divert errors and set up mobile call forwarding, but breached Dead Air twice, never used the customer's name, deflected blame onto customer equipment, and failed Empathy on a crucial safeguarding outburst in the final third.
